sektion_27e_gloss.label: IKEA SEKTION boxes + 27estore high-gloss lacquer fronts
sektion_27e_gloss.note: The only route found with true high gloss, any RAL colour and a published price (32 to 36 USD per sq ft of front). One product image shows a routed integrated handle; no spec for it was found, so ask before ordering. About 6 to 7 weeks.

ringhult_27e_hybrid.label: IKEA RINGHULT gloss white uppers + 27estore gloss lowers
ringhult_27e_hybrid.note: Cheapest gloss two-tone. Uppers are white only and open by push latch; the two gloss surfaces come from two makers and will not match exactly.

voxtorp_gloss.label: IKEA VOXTORP high gloss, integrated handle
voxtorp_gloss.note: In stock, integrated handle, high gloss, but one colour in the US: dark gray-brown. 225 USD per linear ft on the tag in your photo.

voxtorp_matt.label: IKEA VOXTORP matt two-tone, integrated handle
voxtorp_matt.note: Integrated handle and two tones from stock, but matt and not bright.

sektion_bofronts.label: IKEA SEKTION boxes + Bofronts 'Pull' lacquer fronts
sektion_bofronts.note: A recessed integrated pull and any Benjamin Moore colour at no extra cost, with a published price (15x30 door 277 USD). The sheen is not stated and is probably satin.

gs_shaker.label: GS painted shaker (your contractor's line)
gs_shaker.note: The line in your showroom photo. No public price; a like line sells online at about 2,540 USD per 10x10, so this figure is a guess. Painted shaker with pulls.

lioher_shop.label: Local shop, Lioher finger-pull gloss doors
lioher_shop.range: 15,000 to 28,000 USD for this kitchen; quotes needed
lioher_shop.note: A routed finger-pull edge in high gloss, navy over white only. No list price found.

bauformat.label: Bauformat Seattle, handleless gloss lacquer
bauformat.note: German handleless cabinets with lacquered channels, exactly the look, at a showroom 20 minutes away. Another dealer puts kitchens at 25,000 USD and up.

self_assemble.label: You assemble the boxes, installer hangs them

quartz_premium.label: Quartz, Caesarstone or Cambria marble look

quartz_slab.label: Full-height quartz slab, matching the counter

nucore_dolce.label: NuCore Performance Dolce Oak

coretec_premium_coretta.label: COREtec Originals Premium 9 in, Coretta Oak

adura_almond.label: Mannington ADURA Max, Swiss Oak Almond

karndean_baltic.label: Karndean Korlok Select, Baltic Washed Oak

C1.statement: The whole job, kitchen and upstairs floors, costs no more than $60,000 with sales tax and contingency

C2.statement: Every line of the job has a supplier, a quantity and a price

C3.statement: No leg of the cook's triangle (refrigerator, range, and the sink the cook preps at) is longer than 9 ft

C4.statement: The cook's triangle totals no more than 26 ft

C5.statement: The aisle between the long run and the island is at least 42 in

C6.statement: Two people can pass in the work aisle: it is at least 48 in

C7.statement: Someone can stand at the open dishwasher: 21 in clear behind its door

C9.statement: Each island seat has 15 in of knee room

C10.statement: The 5-year-old can use the microwave without reaching up: its bottom is 3 in below their shoulder, or lower

C11.statement: The chosen cabinet line is offered in high gloss, in the chosen lower colour and the chosen lighter upper colour

C12.statement: The cabinets drawn fill each wall to within 1/4 in of its measured length

C13.statement: The uppers beside the sink window clear it by at least 1 in

C14.statement: The plank chosen for the upstairs has a wear layer of 20 mil or more

C15.statement: No cabinet, appliance, counter or shelf occupies the same space as another, or as a wall or post

C16.statement: Every door, drawer and appliance door opens fully without hitting anything

C17.statement: There is at least 36 in of passage on each side of the island
